sql.value: select w.id, w.word, w.category, w.strategy, w.replacement, w.target, w.enable_status, w.sort, w.create_by, w.create_time, w.update_by, w.update_time from ai_sensitive_word w where w.is_deleted = 0 #[and w.word like concat('%', :word, '%')] #[and w.category = :category] #[and w.strategy = :strategy] #[and w.target = :target] #[and w.enable_status = :enableStatus] order by w.sort desc, w.id desc
select id, word, category, strategy, replacement, target, enable_status, sort from ai_sensitive_word where is_deleted = 0 and enable_status = 1 order by sort desc, id desc
